name: pocket-fertilizer-mobile
description: Native Android and iOS shells for Pocket Fertilizer. The app itself is the single index.html at the repo root; this project bundles it so it ships to the app stores and runs entirely offline.

scripts.build: npm run sync-www && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap open ios
scripts.aab: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.apk: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
